# Story 17-9 — branch-only proven-red workflow (D-17-9-FW-07 A, under
# D-17-3d-FW-10's terms). Lives ONLY on `ci/17-9-verify` commit c2 and never
# lands on main. One matrix leg per §Proven-red control: the leg applies its
# plant diff, runs the named suite and must be RED at the named assertion
# (annotation PROVEN-RED); NOT-RED / RED-OTHER annotations are failures of the
# proof. Read-only permissions, no secrets. Generated by
# `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/17-9-evidence/plants/plants.py workflow`.
name: 17-9-proven-red
on:
  push:
    branches: ["ci/17-9-verify"]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  proven-red:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        image: [ubuntu-24.04]
        leg:
          - {"id": "window-rollover", "control": "Window rollover", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test issuance_quota_window_17_9 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 one_pid_keeps_its_capabilities_across_three_windows", "expect": "issuance 1 of 60000 for pid 7"}
          - {"id": "inclusive-capacity", "control": "Inclusive capacity", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test issuance_quota_window_17_9 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 one_pid_keeps_its_capabilities_across_three_windows && cargo test --locked -p maos-capability --test issuance_quota_17_9 capacity_is_inclusive", "expect": "issuance 60000 of 60000 for pid 7"}
          - {"id": "charge-after-policy", "control": "Charge after policy", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test issuance_quota_window_17_9 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 policy_denials_and_approval_required_never_charge", "expect": "right: Err(PolicyDenied)"}
          - {"id": "refund-on-failed-issue", "control": "Refund on failed issue", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test issuance_quota_window_17_9 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 failed_or_late_signing_keeps_capacity_and_crossings_exact", "expect": "issuance 4 of 4 for pid 7"}
          - {"id": "crossing-on-successful-issuance", "control": "Crossing on successful issuance", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test issuance_quota_window_17_9 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 failed_or_late_signing_keeps_capacity_and_crossings_exact", "expect": "right: [(Pressure, 16)]"}
          - {"id": "once-per-window", "control": "Once per window", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test issuance_quota_window_17_9 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 pressure_limit_and_exhausted_fire_once_per_window", "expect": "right: 1"}
          - {"id": "rearm-on-rollover", "control": "Re-arm on rollover", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test issuance_quota_window_17_9 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 pressure_limit_and_exhausted_fire_once_per_window", "expect": "right: [(Pressure, 48000)]"}
          - {"id": "epoch-never-decreases", "control": "Epoch never decreases", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test issuance_quota_window_17_9 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 racing_issuers_never_exceed_or_restore_capacity", "expect": "right: Err(IssuanceQuotaExhausted { spirit_id: 7 })"}
          - {"id": "atomicity", "control": "Atomicity", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test issuance_quota_window_17_9 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 racing_issuers_never_exceed_or_restore_capacity", "expect": "right: 1"}
          - {"id": "strictly-older-sweep", "control": "Strictly-older sweep", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-capability --lib cap_quota", "expect": "overlapping_sweeps_never_remove_a_slot_of_the_current_or_a_later_window"}
          - {"id": "quota-rows-reach-tl", "control": "Quota rows reach the TL", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test issuance_quota_window_17_9 -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 quota_rows_reach_the_transparency_log", "expect": "right: 6"}
          - {"id": "drop-accounting", "control": "Drop accounting", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --test audit_sink_truth_16_5", "expect": "audit_sink_truth_lifecycle_healthy_then_closed"}
          - {"id": "fr4-disposition", "control": "FR4 disposition", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-audit --test fr4_classifier_16_2", "expect": "every_writer_site_demanding_a_disposition_has_one"}
          - {"id": "posture-delta", "control": "Posture delta", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-audit --lib log_composition", "expect": "right: 2"}
          - {"id": "mint-after-bucket", "control": "Mint after bucket (FW-10)", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-kernel-core --features fixture_replay --test schedule_watchdog_fr26 schedule_17_9", "expect": "minted only for admitted fires"}
          - {"id": "ratification-loader-payload", "control": "Ratification loader (select payload)", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-audit --test ratification_loader_17_9", "expect": "every kind-28 row is classified"}
          - {"id": "ratification-loader-decode-all", "control": "Ratification loader (decode every kind-28 row)", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-audit --test ratification_loader_17_9", "expect": "every kind-28 row is classified"}
          - {"id": "session-verdict", "control": "Session verdict", "kind": "wasm", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network,wasm-host --test spawned_scope_17_3c -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 a_delivery_needs_its_iac_send_grant wasm_delivery_is_refused_when_its_issuance_window_is_exhausted", "expect": "right: Some(\"exhausted\")\nleft: Null"}
          - {"id": "recall-typed-denial", "control": "Recall/fetch typed denial", "kind": "wasm", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network --test recall_mediation_17_3d; native=$?; MAOS_17_2_CGROUP_MODE=undelegated MAOS_17_3D_QUOTA_CHILD=recall cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network,wasm-host --test recall_17_3d exhausted_quota_has_receipt_without_tokenless_fallback_call -- --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1; wasm=$?; exit $(( native | wasm ))", "expect": "right: Err(CapabilityDenied)\nguest-visible denial contains no pid, budget or window"}
          - {"id": "mcp-receipt", "control": "MCP receipt", "kind": "plain", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network --test mcp_mint_receipt_17_9; a=$?; cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network --bin maos live_mcp_; b=$?; exit $(( a | b ))", "expect": "exactly one MCP refusal receipt\nexactly one receipt for the one refused mint"}
          - {"id": "cli-refusal", "control": "CLI refusal", "kind": "t3", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network --test cli_wrapper_exhaustion_17_9 exhaustion_refuses_before_workload -- --nocapture --test-threads=1", "expect": "quota exhaustion must refuse before workload launch"}
          - {"id": "confidentiality", "control": "Confidentiality", "kind": "wasm", "cmd": "cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network --test recall_mediation_17_3d quota_audit_and_mcp_receipts_are_operator_visible_but_never_spirit_disclosed -- --exact; a=$?; MAOS_17_2_CGROUP_MODE=undelegated cargo test --locked -p maos-bin --features network,wasm-host --test recall_17_3d kernel_quota_rows_and_mcp_refusals_never_cross_the_guest_recall_boundary -- --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1; b=$?; exit $(( a | b ))", "expect": "thread 'quota_audit_and_mcp_receipts_are_operator_visible_but_never_spirit_disclosed'\nneither operator-only metadata nor either payload reaches the guest"}
    name: red ${{ matrix.leg.id }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.image }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      ID: ${{ matrix.leg.id }}
      KIND: ${{ matrix.leg.kind }}
      CMD: ${{ matrix.leg.cmd }}
      EXPECT: ${{ matrix.leg.expect }}
      DIFFS: _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/17-9-evidence/plants/diffs
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          targets: wasm32-wasip2
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          key: 17-9-red-${{ matrix.leg.kind }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: Keep build and image temporaries off /tmp
        run: echo "TMPDIR=$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - if: ${{ matrix.leg.kind == 'wasm' }}
        name: WASM prerequisites (pinned assembler, offline guest fixtures)
        run: |
          cargo install --locked wasm-tools --version 1.259.0
          cargo fetch --locked
          for fixture in crates/maos-wasm-host/guests/echo-spirit crates/maos-wasm-host/guests/routed-relay crates/maos-wasm-host/guests/recall-probe crates/maos-wasm-host/guests/compat-echo-2-0 crates/maos-wasm-host/guests/equiv-fixture/native-twin; do
            cargo fetch --locked --manifest-path "$fixture/Cargo.toml"
          done
      - if: ${{ matrix.leg.kind == 't3' }}
        uses: ./.github/actions/provision-t3-test-substrate
      - if: ${{ matrix.leg.kind == 't3' }}
        name: T3 prerequisites (Worker CLI fixture, locked graph)
        run: |
          cargo build --locked -p worker --bin worker-cli-fixture
          cargo fetch --locked
      - name: Apply the plant and require RED at the named assertion
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          sha=$(sha256sum "$DIFFS/$ID.diff" | cut -d' ' -f1)
          echo "::notice title=17-9 provenance $ID (${{ matrix.image }})::sha=${GITHUB_SHA} tree=$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}) plant_sha256=${sha} rustc=$(rustc --version | tr ' ' '_')"
          git apply --whitespace=nowarn "$DIFFS/$ID.diff" || { echo "::error title=PLANT-DID-NOT-APPLY $ID::git apply failed"; exit 1; }
          case "$KIND" in
            wasm) python3 scripts/run_cgroup_ceiling_17_2.py run --mode undelegated --unit "maos-17-2-red-17-9-$ID" --timeout 2400 -- \
                    bash -o pipefail -c "$CMD" > red.log 2>&1 ;;
            t3)   python3 scripts/run_cgroup_ceiling_17_2.py run --mode delegated --unit "maos-17-7-red-17-9-$ID" --timeout 1800 --rootless-canary -- \
                    bash -o pipefail -c "$CMD" > red.log 2>&1 ;;
            *)    bash -o pipefail -c "$CMD" > red.log 2>&1 ;;
          esac
          rc=$?
          missing=""
          while IFS= read -r want; do
            [ -z "$want" ] && continue
            grep -qF -- "$want" red.log || missing="${missing}[${want}] "
          done <<< "$EXPECT"
          grep -E 'panicked at|^test .* FAILED$' red.log | head -6 | while IFS= read -r line; do
            echo "::notice title=17-9 red evidence $ID (${{ matrix.image }})::${line}"
          done
          if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ -z "$missing" ]; then
            first=$(printf '%s\n' "$EXPECT" | head -n1)
            echo "::error title=PROVEN-RED $ID (${{ matrix.image }})::rc=${rc} red at the named assertion: $(grep -m1 -F -- "$first" red.log | cut -c1-300)"
          elif [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "::error title=NOT-RED $ID (${{ matrix.image }})::the plant was not detected (rc=0)"
          else
            echo "::error title=RED-OTHER $ID (${{ matrix.image }})::rc=${rc} but missing ${missing}"
          fi
          exit 1
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: red-${{ matrix.leg.id }}
          path: red.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
